title: MLLPA
summary: A documented and reusable Python module for machine-learning-assisted analysis of lipid-membrane phases obtained from molecular-dynamics simulations.

researchTopic.label: Research topic
researchTopic.value: Lipid membranes, phase transitions and membrane instabilities.

computationalApproaches.label: Computational approaches
computationalApproaches.value: Molecular simulation, data analysis and machine learning.

publications.label: Publications
publications.value: Three first-author articles on lipid membranes and MLLPA.

paragraphs: MLLPA makes reusable the methods developed to study the phases and transitions of simulated lipid membranes.
The module structures the processing of data obtained from molecular-dynamics simulations and supports the analysis of membrane phases using machine-learning approaches.
Vivien developed approximately 95% of the module’s code and created its entire website and documentation. The software, its website and documentation are publicly available.
